kind=automated id=CK3 required=true cwd=. budget=60 command=bun -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const dir='src/conformance';const q=String.fromCharCode(34);const re=new RegExp('test(?:\\.skipIf\\([^)]*\\))?\\(\\s*'+q+'([^'+q+']*)'+q,'g');const titles=[];for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.test.ts'))){const s=fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,f),'utf8');for(const m of s.matchAll(re))titles.push(m[1])}titles.sort();const base=fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,'test-titles.txt'),'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).sort();const lost=base.filter(t=>!titles.includes(t));const gained=titles.filter(t=>!base.includes(t));if(lost.length||gained.length||base.length===0){console.error('titles: baseline '+base.length+', now '+titles.length+', lost: '+lost.join(' ; ')+', gained: '+gained.join(' ; '));process.exit(1)}console.log('titles: '+titles.length)"
